options.content:
**Dashboard 3 of 4 (Section 12.4).** AML-pack-specific activity: `ofac-sanctions` + `transaction-graph` only (Phase 3 Days 11-14).

Top panels backed by `agg_aml_pack_daily` (synthetic data, fixed 2026-07-06 to 2026-08-03 window). `sanctions_matches` is an illustrative ~35% placeholder rate, not a measured confidence score -- no real match-confidence field exists on synthetic rows the way Day 11's real rapidfuzz score does.

Bottom panel (risk score distribution) is **real, not synthetic** -- see that panel's own description -- and uses a trailing 30-day window instead.

panels.title: OFAC call volume + illustrative sanctions match rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, 'OFAC calls' AS metric, ofac_calls AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT day, 'Sanctions matches (illustrative)', sanctions_matches
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        ORDER BY time

SELECT day AS time, transaction_graph_calls AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        ORDER BY day

SELECT sum(structuring_alerts) AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)

SELECT 'Denied' AS metric, sum(mark_investigated_denied) AS value
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'HITL-approved', sum(mark_investigated_approved)
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Auto-passed (synthetic-only, see how-to-read)', sum(mark_investigated_auto_passed)
        FROM agg_aml_pack_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Session-level risk score distribution (real, last 30 days)
panels.description: Agent A1's session risk score (interpose.control_plane.agents.policy_evaluator), bucketed. Still written to the live Redis hash (interpose:session:{id}) for other agents' cheap reads, but now also snapshotted to risk_score_snapshots on every decision -- this panel reads that history directly, not a Spark aggregate (real control-plane volume doesn't need one; see interpose.control_plane.models).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN risk_score < 0.2 THEN '0.0-0.2'
            WHEN risk_score < 0.4 THEN '0.2-0.4'
            WHEN risk_score < 0.6 THEN '0.4-0.6'
            WHEN risk_score < 0.8 THEN '0.6-0.8'
            ELSE '0.8-1.0'
          END AS bucket,
          count(*) AS value
        FROM risk_score_snapshots
        WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 1
